create_seq2seq_jit_model: create a Seq2SeqJIT TorchScript model with source and target vocabularies for sequence generation
run_seq2seq_forward: run the Seq2SeqJIT forward pass to generate hypotheses from source tokens with optional dict features
prepare_generator_inputs: prepare generator input tensors from word ids, dict features, and contextual embeddings for sequence generation
get_single_unk_token: get the first unknown token string from source tokens when copy unk token is enabled
get_target_length: get the target sequence length using a quadratic formula capped by a maximum length
